Responsibilities

Workato is looking for a manager who can take our talented EMEA SDR team to the next level. Not just by managing activity, but by rebuilding how we find and create pipeline in an AI-first buying environment. Outbound has changed: buyers are harder to interrupt, signal-based prospecting has replaced spray-and-pray, and AI tools now do in minutes what used to take an SDR a full day of research. We need a leader who has already adapted to that shift and can bring the team with them.

You'll own the strategy, performance, and culture of the EMEA SDR org, reporting to the Senior Director, EMEA Growth Marketing, and working closely with regional sales leaders, marketing, Account Executives to build a predictable, scalable pipeline engine, while developing the next generation of Workato Account Executives.

What You'll Do

Team leadership & development

- Recruit, coach, and manage the EMEA team of SDRs; build a strong bench for promotion into Account Executive roles

- Build and continuously refine a structured onboarding and ramp program that gets new SDRs to full productivity faster

- Use call recordings, sequence performance, and CRM activity data to drive targeted, individualized coaching rather than generic training

AI-driven pipeline generation

- Design and evolve outbound strategies that combine intent data, buyer signals, and AI-powered prospecting and research tools to prioritize the right accounts at the right moment, rather than working static lead lists

- Partner with RevOps/Sales Ops to ensure intent, enrichment, and engagement data flow cleanly into Salesforce and Outreach so the team is always acting on the freshest signal

Cross-functional GTM strategy

- Partner with marketing to translate campaigns, ICP, and positioning into outbound messaging and multi-touch sequences that convert

- Work with regional sales leaders and AEs to tighten SDR-to-opportunity handoff and improve conversion rates through the funnel

Operating Rigor & Reporting

- Own team quota: monthly, quarterly, and annual targets

- Report on pipeline metrics, trends, and forecasted headcount needs to leadership

- Build dashboards and processes that make performance and pipeline health visible in real time, not just in QBRs

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

- 3-5 years of being an SDR / BDR Manager, OR having similar experience, ideally in B2B Technology

- Experience successfully managing entry level salespeople to achieve performance goals

- Proven track record of consistently exceeding against quota and outlined metrics

- Proven ability to be a strong coach

- Strong experience working with Salesforce.com, Outreach.io, and SDR business intelligence tools, or similar.

- Strong ability to conduct analysis and make decisions based on data

- ​​A competitive & resilient growth mindset

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

- A bias-for-action type person who hates letting broken things stay that way

- Strong ability to conduct analysis and make decisions based on data

- ​​A competitive & resilient growth mindset

In this role, you will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of high-impact field marketing programs — trade shows, executive-level programs, and regional activations — that connect Workato sales and leadership with prospects, customers, partners, and our developer community to drive new logos, accelerate deals, expand accounts, and fuel pipeline.

In this role, y ou will also be responsible to:

-
Owning the strategy and end-to-end execution of events, experiences and executive program calendar across North America aligning investment to pipeline and revenue priorities

-
Partner closely with sales and extended teams including Demand Generation, Product Marketing to ensure the right implementation of programs to drive pipeline and ROI

-
Designing and leading executive briefings, roundtables, and account-based field programs in close partnership with sales leadership and the ABM team

-
Building and scaling our sales enablement event motion, including training, webinars, and workshops that arm sellers to drive pipeline for core sales team.

-
Leading regional field activations — dinners, sponsorships, and co-branded events with partners and customers — from concept through measurable results

-
Managing relationships with internal stakeholders, agencies, and vendors to deliver seamless, on-brand event experiences, negotiating contracts and holding partners accountable to scope and budget

-
Setting the standard for post-event reporting and pipeline attribution, delivering insights and recommendations to sales and marketing leadership

-
Building and maintaining the North America field marketing calendar and strategy, keeping cross-functional teams aligned and prioritized

-
Mentoring and providing guidance to field marketing associates/coordinators supporting program execution

-
Acting as a strategic advisor to regional sales leaders, translating pipeline and account goals into targeted field marketing plans

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

-
5–8+ years of B2B field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS

-
Proven track record designing and executing regional marketing programs that measurably contributed to pipeline and bookings targets

-
Experience owning a field marketing budget, including forecasting, vendor negotiation, and ROI reporting

-
Demonstrated success planning and running executive-level programs (briefings, roundtables, advisory events) for enterprise audiences

-
Working knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) principles and experience partnering with ABM and sales teams on account-level strategy

-
Proficiency with Salesforce, Marketo, and event platforms such as Cvent; comfort working with pipeline and attribution reporting

-
Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or coordinators is a plus

-
Willingness to travel across North America as needed to support events (approximately 25–40%)

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

-
Strategic thinker who can also roll up their sleeves to execute flawlessly under tight timelines

-
Confident, credible communicator who can influence and align senior sales and marketing stakeholders

-
Highly organized program manager comfortable owning multiple concurrent, high-visibility initiatives

-
Data-driven approach to measuring program impact and making the case for continued or reallocated investment

-
Collaborative operator who builds trust quickly with global, cross-functional teams, partners, and vendors
